title: Open Liveries operators
description: Operators that fly in another airline's paint (a regional in its mainline's, a subsidiary in its parent's), by their own ICAO code: whose scheme they wear. A jet flying under one of these callsigns is drawn in that scheme unless it's tagged otherwise in airframes/.

wears.description: The scheme it flies in, as a livery ref: <airline>/<id> (liveries/<airline>/<id>.json).

note.description: Who the operator is and why it's in that paint, for a reader.
